title: 案
teacherNotes: Formal Editor handoff assigned to Production A. Base origin/main 29406e21 with formal L001-L465 招 and 469 unique learned Han. L467-L471 provide provisional 活、該、應、答、題; Release must also satisfy R057/R058 after L465. Allowed set has 475 unique Han. 反、植、汽 remain forbidden. S01 uses facial expression only, with no blocks or checking tools. S05 bag remains completely blank and undecorated. Production package only; Release owns shared production integration and main merge.

sentences.imageNotes: 家中書桌，主角小女孩看著自己的作業，皺眉、露出疑惑表情，指著作業向旁邊的主角爸爸詢問。爸爸專注看她指的地方。老師最後明確修正：不放積木，不放計數工具或其他核對道具，只靠疑惑表情和互動表達。作業內容不需可讀，不必把錯誤答案具體畫出來。
sentences.imagePrompt: Square 1:1 rich warm detailed pencil-and-watercolor modern children picture-book illustration. Use the approved L058 set as STYLE ONLY, with natural refined preschool-child proportions, warm Taiwan environments, rich paper and fabric texture, clear safe action, uncluttered phone-readable composition and safe margins. Preserve recurring cast identities from the approved family and teacher anchors. Recurring protagonist girl: preschool child with short dark-brown bob, pink hair clip, expressive dark eyes, pink cardigan over cream blouse, navy skirt and pink shoes. Recurring mother: adult woman with warm brown bob, cream blouse and blue jeans. Recurring father: adult man with short dark hair, warm approachable face, pale-blue collared shirt and khaki trousers. Generic people remain visually distinct. No visible or readable text, letters, numbers, equations, labels, brands, logos, captions, symbols, or watermarks. At the home study desk, the recurring protagonist girl looks at her own open workbook with a clearly puzzled frown. She points to one place on the page and turns to ask the recurring father seated beside her; father leans in and looks attentively at exactly where she points. Express that the answer seems strange only through her doubtful face and their interaction. The workbook content is angled away and unreadable. Absolutely no building blocks, counters, counting tools, calculator, checking aids, correction marks, legible answer, equation, or numbers.

sentences.imageNotes: 家中，主角爸爸和主角小女孩玩看局部猜動物的圖卡遊戲。爸爸展示一張動物局部圖，女孩剛選出的完整動物圖卡與之不符；爸爸溫和示意再觀察，女孩收回手、認真思考。靠圖像明確表現是猜錯後再想，不需題目文字、數字或打叉符號；不是責罵，也不直接揭露正解。
sentences.imagePrompt: Square 1:1 rich warm detailed pencil-and-watercolor modern children picture-book illustration. Use the approved L058 set as STYLE ONLY, with natural refined preschool-child proportions, warm Taiwan environments, rich paper and fabric texture, clear safe action, uncluttered phone-readable composition and safe margins. Preserve recurring cast identities from the approved family and teacher anchors. Recurring protagonist girl: preschool child with short dark-brown bob, pink hair clip, expressive dark eyes, pink cardigan over cream blouse, navy skirt and pink shoes. Recurring mother: adult woman with warm brown bob, cream blouse and blue jeans. Recurring father: adult man with short dark hair, warm approachable face, pale-blue collared shirt and khaki trousers. Generic people remain visually distinct. No visible or readable text, letters, numbers, equations, labels, brands, logos, captions, symbols, or watermarks. At home, recurring father and recurring girl play a picture-card game about guessing an animal from a close-up detail. Father holds one card showing only a distinctive cropped animal detail such as spotted fur and a curved ear. On the table, the girl's just-selected full-animal card clearly does not match that detail. Father gently gestures to look again; the girl pulls her hand back and studies both cards thoughtfully. Make the incorrect guess and renewed thinking visible through image differences and body language. Do not reveal the correct full animal. No scolding, red X, written question, numbers, or text.

sentences.imageNotes: 小學教室各自作答，主角小女孩偏頭想看旁邊 generic 同學的作業紙，固定老師在旁溫和但明確地指回女孩自己的紙。老師使用低髮髻、圓框眼鏡、墨綠襯衫與深藍教師背心的明確教師造型，不能像主角媽媽。不是合作討論或互相核對。「你」指被老師提醒的主角小女孩，不要換成固定「你」小男孩；鄰座用 generic 同學即可，不需小光、小月。紙上無需可讀內容。
sentences.imagePrompt: Square 1:1 rich warm detailed pencil-and-watercolor modern children picture-book illustration. Use the approved L058 set as STYLE ONLY, with natural refined preschool-child proportions, warm Taiwan environments, rich paper and fabric texture, clear safe action, uncluttered phone-readable composition and safe margins. Preserve recurring cast identities. Recurring protagonist girl: preschool child with short dark-brown bob, pink hair clip, expressive dark eyes, pink cardigan over cream blouse, navy skirt and pink shoes. The recurring school teacher must be visually distinct from the protagonist mother: dark hair neatly tied in a low bun, thin round glasses, muted teal collared blouse under a navy classroom vest, charcoal ankle-length trousers, practical dark flats, and a blank teacher lanyard; no cream blouse, cardigan, apron, jeans, or mother-like home styling. Generic people remain visually distinct. No visible or readable text, letters, numbers, equations, labels, brands, logos, captions, symbols, or watermarks. In a primary-school classroom during quiet individual work, the recurring protagonist girl tilts her head and eyes toward a neighboring generic classmate's paper. The recurring teacher stands nearby and gently but clearly points back to the girl's own separate paper. Desks and body orientation must show independent answering, not collaboration or checking together. The reminded child is the recurring girl; the neighbor is a generic classmate unlike Xiaoguang or Xiaoyue. Papers remain unreadable and contain no legible marks, words, numbers, or answers. Calm correction, no humiliation.
